title: FY 2082/83 third-quarter financial report published
description: UTKHPL published its third-quarter financial report, providing a current company disclosure for operating and financial monitoring.
source_title: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Limited project updates

title: FY 2079/80 and 2080/81 annual reports published
description: UTKHPL published its sixteenth and seventeenth annual reports covering the two fiscal years.
source_title: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Limited annual reports

title: SJVN management reviewed project progress
description: SJVN recorded a management review of Arun-3; the event confirms active construction but does not by itself establish a comparable physical-progress percentage.

title: Current ownership and early-stage status recorded
description: ICRA recorded the proposed ownership split among GMR, SJVN, IREDA and NEA and described the project as being at a very early stage of development.
source_title: ICRA rating rationale for GMR Energy Limited

title: Ninth Panel of Experts report disclosed
description: ADB disclosed the ninth environmental and social Panel of Experts report for the active Tanahu project.

title: FY 2024/25 audited project financial statements disclosed
description: ADB disclosed audited project financial statements for 16 July 2024 to 16 July 2025.

title: Letter of intent published
description: BGJCL published a current letter-of-intent notice, demonstrating active procurement activity without establishing construction commencement.

title: AIIB proposed-project summary disclosed
description: AIIB listed Dudhkoshi as proposed, Category A, with USD 200 million of proposed sovereign financing and ADB as lead co-financier.

title: Development teaser issued for market sounding
description: DKJVCL issued a market-sounding teaser for the current 600 MW main powerhouse plus 70 MW dam-toe design basis.

title: Draft final DPR submitted
description: India's Ministry of Jal Shakti records that WAPCOS submitted the draft final DPR in November 2016; a mutually acceptable final DPR remains unresolved.
source_title: Ministry of Jal Shakti Pancheshwar project page

title: Re-regulating dam application visible in DoED register
description: DoED's current application register includes a separate 271.5 MW Mugu Karnali Re-regulating Dam Hydropower Project promoted by VUCL.

title: Dhalkebar-Inaruwa segment entered operation
description: The eastern Dhalkebar-Inaruwa segment is treated as operational while the Hetauda-Dhalkebar segment remains under construction.

title: Cross-border line groundbreaking held
description: The governments of India and Nepal jointly carried out the groundbreaking of the 400 kV Gorakhpur-Butwal transmission line.
source_title: Embassy of India bilateral visit record

title: POWERGRID reported the implementing joint venture
description: POWERGRID reported that the Indian portion is implemented through a 50:50 joint venture with NEA and recorded paid-up capital at 31 March 2025.
